plan.title: BLOCKER 0.123.0 still fail-closes Visage vbrief:validate on proposed/active history after #5427; consumer remains on 0.119.2

narratives.Description: Prefer-A Bound for #5467: demote three Visage vbrief:validate fail classes to warnings across VALID_PLAN_STATUSES under envelope 0.8.
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy

1. Keep envelope 0.8.
2. Demote unknown reserved-prefix subtypes to warnings for every VALID_PLAN_STATUSES member without widening isTerminalPlanStatus (packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/schema.ts).
3. Warn-accept leftover colon-form clause ids on the same status membership (packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/schema.ts).
4. Writers mint dotted clause-keyed ids only (packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts).
5. Route failed PlanItem missing invalidates to warnings on completed plans (packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/schema.ts).
6. Keep demoted-class warnings visible on the consumer validate path (packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/schema-v08.test.ts).
7. Normative fixtures for the three demoted classes (packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/schema-v08.test.ts).
8. Prefer-A clears the Visage 4.9.179 fail classes as warnings on a published engine newer than 0.119.2 without rewriting the consumer corpus.

Reject: per-consumer CLASS_B growth; rewrite of historical briefs as the upgrade path; envelope bump alone; leave #5427 terminal-only as shipped.
